title: Roles
description: What each role grants and where it can be bound: the roles part of plat5.yml.

roles.title: roles
roles.description: Map of slug → role. At least one role.

default_role.title: default_role
default_role.description: Required. What joining a root grants. Bindable at every root kind other than the sign-in kind. No `max_duration`: joining without a stated end must grant something that doesn't need one.

creator_role.title: creator_role
creator_role.description: Required. What the creator of a node gets on it. Bindable at every kind that can be created. No `max_duration`.

labels.title: labels
labels.description: `[a-z0-9:._-]+`, max 64 chars, unique, max 64 labels. `[]` grants nothing. `["*"]` grants every label; `*` is valid only alone.

bindable_at.title: bindable_at
bindable_at.description: Required. The kinds this role can be bound at. Never the sign-in kind.

max_duration.title: max_duration
max_duration.description: Optional. A binding with this role must have an `expires_at` no further away than this. A duration: a whole number and `s`, `m`, `h` or `d` (`7d`, `8h`).
